messages:
maria: Kicking off kernel v3.7.2 + quant v1.9 cutover in the night window. Plan: staged slices 4/16/80 with an 8m hold after each slice. Will pin current driver on fallback pool before first slice. Deploybot scheduled at 23:00 UTC. Post smoke and eval diffs here.

deploybot: queued rollout job engine-prod:kernel-3.7.2|quant-1.9 -> scheduled start 1716003000 (23:00 UTC). Dryrun checks OK. I will annotate each slice and emit metrics links.

ajay: small ask — can we make first slice 2% instead of 4%? last minor swap earlier had a micro-flap at 5.

maria: 2% would be fine but ops asked for slightly larger to get KV/LRU signal. keeping 4% for first slice.

leon: rollback triggers (explicit):
- p99 latency increase > 200ms over baseline sustained 3m
- error rate > 0.5% (5xx model infra) over 3m
- any GPU OOM or process crash > 0
If any trigger hits, we pin kernel-3.7.1 on fallback pool and pull traffic back.

sophie: metrics to watch: p50/p95/p99 latency, 5xx rate, kv-evict-rates, model-quality diffs on eval set, and mempeak. I will run the smoke eval after slice starts.

sophie: smoke eval command (will post results):
```
# smoke eval
./tools/eval_diff.sh --model quant-1.9 --samples 500 --report=artifact
```

deploybot: slice 1 (4%) started across region-us-west-1. trace: https://dash.internal/redwood/rollouts/1716001234/slice1 :eyes:

ajay: seeing a ~30ms increase in p50 on the edge cluster, p99 unchanged so far. :thinking_face:

ops-bot: pin action created: fallback pool pinned to kernel-3.7.1 until 2026-03-22T06:00:00Z for quick rollback. (pin-id: pin-20260321-7b9c)

sophie: smoke eval finished: small lexical drift in 12/500 samples (2.4%), diffs attached to artifact https://artifacts.internal/redwood/evals/1716001234. No obvious hallucination pattern.

leon: confirm thresholds not crossed. proceed to slice 2 (16%) after 8m hold if no regressions.

maria: release-notes snippet for draft: "Kernel v3.7.2: matmul microkernel rewrite, ~7% mempeak reduction on long seqs; Quant v1.9: tighter requantization path to reduce tail latency." Add to changelog. :memo:

ajay: thumbs up from infra. keep an eye on eviction counters — last time we got silent cache churn.

deploybot: slice 1 hold completed, moving to slice 2 (16%). annotated rollout: https://dash.internal/redwood/rollouts/1716001234/annotations

maria: moving to 16% now. will update thread if anything goes sideways. :thumbsup:
